thread:
maria: Hey team — planning to pin model 'lyra-lite-v2' into the catalog slot tomorrow. Target window: 2025-11-12 10:30 PST (canary then swap). Who can own smoke and be ready to rollback if needed?
kevin: I can take smoke for the 10:30 window. Will be available +30m after for validation.
sai: I'll be on-call for rollback readiness. Can have rollback runbook up 10m before start.
maria: Awesome. Kevin — smoke checklist: quick latencies, sample prompts, and a small eval on the canary pool. Can you post the smoke commands you plan to run?
kevin: Yep — plan is minimal by design. Commands: ```
# verify canary is serving
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"lyra-lite-v2","input":"The capital of France is"}' | jq .
# latency sample
time curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"lyra-lite-v2","input":"Summarize: <short doc>"}'
```
kevin: I'll also run 50 small concurrent requests to check for queueing. If p95 > 800ms we abort and rollback.
jen: Quick heads up — need to ensure the catalog pinning job respects the pin TTL flag we discussed. ops-bot: is TTL set for this slot?
ops-bot: TTL on pin slot 42 currently set to 72 hours. Adjust with `/pinctl set-ttl 42 48h` if you want shorter.`
maria: Let's leave at 72h for now — we might want to keep a rollback window.
sai: Rollback runbook (brief): 1) set catalog weight back to previous version 2) drain canary 3) promote previous model if drain OK 4) notify infra and open incident if errors persist. I'll post exact commands 30m prior.
kevin: One more: I'll capture a sample of token-level cost estimates from the route after canary. If token cost delta > 10% we flag.
maria: Who's doing the actual pin operation? I can run the pin job but prefer to hand off to @kevin for the final swap so I can monitor dashboards.
kevin: I can execute the swap. Plan: pin to slot 42 in catalog, wait 5m, swap traffic 5->95% in 10m, then 100%. If no regressions, finalize.
maria: Cool. Please post the deploy job id when you kick it off.
deploy-bot: Job started: job/lyra-pin-1748888888 at 2025-11-12T17:30:00Z (canary pool: canary-3, slot:42) :rocket:
kevin: Kicking off smoke now (starting with single probe).
kevin: Smoke probe result: ok, output matches baseline sample. p50 120ms, p95 310ms.
sai: Observability looks clean so far. No increase in throttles.
kevin: Starting 5->95% ramp now.
jen: Quick check: tracing shows no error spikes in backend. Good to continue.
kevin: Swapped to 100%. Monitoring for 10m.
kevin: Post-swap checks: sample eval pass rate 98.5%, token cost +3%. No rollback.
maria: Thanks all. I'll file the catalog note and add the pin metadata (operator: kevin, reason: quality-improvement, expires: 72h).
sai: I'll stay watching for another 30m. Ping me if anything odd.
maria: Closing out — great job. :tada:
